28def _is_non_overlapping_and_dense(t): 

29 """True when every element of ``t`` names exactly one storage slot. 

30 

31 Mirrors ``at::is_non_overlapping_and_dense``: two distinct elements never 

32 share a memory location (no internal overlap) and the tensor covers its 

33 storage without gaps (dense). Size-1 dimensions are ignored, since their 

34 stride is irrelevant to which address an element names. A stride-2 slice, 

35 for example, is overlap-free but not dense, and ATen's fused-optimizer 

36 fast path rejects it for exactly that reason. 

37 """ 

38 if t.numel() <= 1: 

39 return True 

40 sizes_strides = sorted((s, sz) for sz, s in zip(t.shape, t.stride()) if sz != 1) 

41 expected = 1 

42 for stride, size in sizes_strides: 

43 if stride != expected: 

44 return False 

45 expected *= size 

46 return True 

47 

48 

49def _strides_match(a, b): 

50 """ATen's ``_check_tensors_share_sizes_and_strides``: strides of ``a`` and 

51 ``b`` agree on every dimension whose size is not 1 (a size-1 dimension's 

52 stride is irrelevant to which element an index names).""" 

53 if a.shape != b.shape: 

54 return False 

55 for size, sa, sb in zip(a.shape, a.stride(), b.stride()): 

56 if size != 1 and sa != sb: 

57 return False 

58 return True

61def _storage_view(t): 

62 """Flat 1-D view of ``t`` in *storage* order. 

63 

64 The elementwise Adagrad step needs each logical element to line up across 

65 ``param``/``grad``/``state_sum``. When all three share a shape and a 

66 non-overlapping-and-dense stride set, walking them in storage order visits 

67 the same logical element at the same relative position in each, so flat 

68 indexing on these views is correct for any such layout -- including a 

69 transposed tensor, which ``is_contiguous()`` would have rejected. 

70 """ 

71 if t.is_contiguous(): 

72 return t.reshape(-1) 

73 return t.as_strided((t.numel(),), (1,))

78def _fused_adagrad_kernel( 

79 param, 

80 grad, 

81 state_sum, 

82 state_step, # scalar tensor holding the optimizer step (read on-device) 

83 n: tl.constexpr, 

84 BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr, 

85 ACC_DTYPE: tl.constexpr, 

86 lr: tl.constexpr, 

87 lr_decay: tl.constexpr, 

88 weight_decay: tl.constexpr, 

89 eps: tl.constexpr, 

90 maximize: tl.constexpr,

96 # Get the block index and compute the offsets for this block. 

97 pid = tle.program_id(0) 

98 offsets = pid * BLOCK_SIZE + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE) 

99 mask = offsets < n 

100 

101 # Early skip: if a non-finite gradient was found, leave the buffers untouched. 

102 # ATen tests ``found_inf == 1`` rather than ``> 0``: any other value (including 

103 # 2.0) still performs the update, so the comparison has to be exact. 

104 if has_found_inf: 

105 found_inf_val = tl.load(found_inf) 

106 if found_inf_val == 1: 

107 return 

108 

109 # Read the optimizer step on-device to avoid a host sync (`.item()`). 

110 step = tl.load(state_step).to(ACC_DTYPE) 

111 

112 # Load the parameter, gradient, and running sum of squared gradients. 

113 param_load = tl.load(param + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0) 

114 grad_load = tl.load(grad + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0) 

115 state_sum_load = tl.load(state_sum + offsets, mask=mask, other=0.0) 

116 

117 # Promote low-precision values to the accumulation type for the math (mirrors 

118 # opmath_type in the reference C++ implementation). fp16/bf16/fp32 accumulate 

119 # in fp32; fp64 keeps full double precision, which ATen also does -- computing 

120 # a double parameter in fp32 would lose ~7 digits. 

121 param_f = param_load.to(ACC_DTYPE) 

122 grad_f = grad_load.to(ACC_DTYPE) 

123 state_sum_f = state_sum_load.to(ACC_DTYPE) 

124 

125 # Gradient unscaling (for AMP). ``grad`` is treated as read-only here: the 

126 # native CUDA kernel only leaves an unscaled value behind for tail elements 

127 # when numel is not a multiple of its vector width (4), so that write-back is 

128 # a vectorization artifact rather than part of the operator contract and is 

129 # deliberately not reproduced. 

130 if has_grad_scale: 

131 grad_scale_val = tl.load(grad_scale) 

132 grad_f = grad_f / grad_scale_val 

133 

134 # Handle maximize mode: negate the gradient for gradient ascent. 

135 if maximize: 

136 grad_f = -grad_f 

137 

138 # Apply weight decay (L2 penalty added to the gradient). 

139 if weight_decay > 0: 

140 grad_f = grad_f + param_f * weight_decay 

141 

142 # Accumulate the squared gradient: state_sum += grad * grad 

143 state_sum_f = state_sum_f + grad_f * grad_f 

144 

145 # Corrected learning rate: lr / (1 + (step - 1) * lr_decay) 

146 corrected_lr = lr / (1.0 + (step - 1.0) * lr_decay) 

147 

148 # Update the parameter: param -= corrected_lr * grad / (sqrt(state_sum) + eps) 

149 param_f = param_f - corrected_lr * grad_f / (tl.sqrt(state_sum_f) + eps) 

150 

151 # Store the updated values back, downcasting to the original element dtype. 

152 tl.store(param + offsets, param_f.to(param_load.dtype), mask=mask) 

153 tl.store(state_sum + offsets, state_sum_f.to(state_sum_load.dtype), mask=mask)

157 params, 

158 grads, 

159 state_sums, 

160 state_steps, 

161 *, 

162 lr, 

163 lr_decay, 

164 weight_decay, 

165 eps, 

166 maximize, 

167 grad_scale, 

168 found_inf, 

169): 

170 """Shared driver for the fused Adagrad step. 

171 

172 Performs one step of the Adagrad optimizer for each parameter: 

173 

174 corrected_lr = lr / (1 + (step - 1) * lr_decay) 

175 g = grad / grad_scale (only when grad_scale is provided) 

176 g = -g (only when maximize is set) 

177 g = g + weight_decay * param (only when weight_decay > 0) 

178 state_sum += g * g 

179 param = param - corrected_lr * g / (sqrt(state_sum) + eps) 

180 

181 ``state_steps`` is incremented by the caller; the step value is read on 

182 device inside the kernel to avoid a host synchronization. When 

183 ``found_inf == 1`` the update is skipped entirely (AMP recovery), matching 

184 ATen's exact comparison -- other nonzero values still apply the update. 

185 ``grads`` is read-only: only ``params`` and ``state_sums`` are mutated. 

186 """ 

187 has_grad_scale = grad_scale is not None 

188 has_found_inf = found_inf is not None 

189 grad_scale_ptr = grad_scale if has_grad_scale else None 

190 found_inf_ptr = found_inf if has_found_inf else None

192 # Validate the whole batch before touching any buffer. These values drive raw 

193 # pointer arithmetic in the kernel, and a partially applied step is not 

194 # recoverable, so every list has to be checked up front rather than lazily 

195 # inside the launch loop.

198 ("grads", grads), 

199 ("state_sums", state_sums),

208 # Mirror ATen's fast-path restriction check 

209 # (``check_fast_path_restrictions`` in ForeachUtils.h), which the native CUDA

211 # device, and every tensor in params/grads/state_sums must match that 

212 # dtype/device, be strided, and be non-overlapping and dense; corresponding 

213 # entries must additionally share sizes and strides. This makes the check 

214 # *global*: a params list mixing fp32 and fp64 (each entry internally

216 # before any kernel launch, so a rejected batch leaves every buffer

220 expected_dtype = params[0].dtype

224 "_fused_adagrad_ only supports float16/bfloat16/float32/float64 "

230 ("param", param), 

231 ("grad", grad), 

232 ("state_sum", state_sum),

236 "params, grads, and state_sums must have same dtype, " 

237 f"device, and layout: {name}[{i}] dtype {tensor.dtype} " 

238 f"differs from params[0] dtype {expected_dtype}" 

239 ) 

240 if tensor.device != expected_device: 

241 raise RuntimeError( 

242 "params, grads, and state_sums must have same dtype, " 

243 f"device, and layout: {name}[{i}] device {tensor.device} "

265 f"_fused_adagrad_: {name}[{i}] strides {other.stride()} "

269 # ``state_steps``: ATen passes each step tensor's raw data pointer to the 

270 # kernel, which blindly reinterprets it as ``float``. That makes float32 the
